weeks.title: Find your starting line

tasks.text: Take the free mini mock once (20 questions). Do it today.
Write down your 3 weakest areas from the results page. Three lines, no more.
Pick one fixed 60 minute slot and put it in your calendar for all 7 days this week.
Check your registration status with the test organizer for your country. Do this 1 time, this week. Their notice comes first.
Study 22 grammar items this week, 3 a day. Read one blog article per item, then write one sentence of your own.
Learn 5 kanji a day, 35 this week.
Learn 15 new words a day. That is 105 this week. Say each word aloud with one example sentence.
Do 10 minutes of listening a day, 70 minutes this week. Use a listening section from the mock in practice mode, with the script open.

weeks.done: You have 3 weak areas written down, a fixed daily slot, and one finished mini mock.

weeks.title: First full mock

tasks.text: Take the full mock at real exam time, 115 minutes, in one sitting. No pausing.
Write down 3 numbers from the results: LK plus Reading, Listening, Total.
Look at the 1 weak area the mock showed. Mark the week with that skill as your Start here week.
Study 22 grammar items this week, 3 a day, after the mock day.
Learn 5 kanji a day, 35 this week.
Learn 15 new words a day. That is 105 this week. Say each word aloud with one example sentence.
Do 10 minutes of listening a day, 70 minutes this week. Use a listening section from the mock in practice mode, with the script open.

weeks.done: You finished the full mock in one sitting and have your 3 scores written down.

weeks.title: Fix what broke

tasks.text: Study 22 new grammar items, 3 a day.
Redo the 22 grammar items you got wrong in the mock. Second pass: write 1 new sentence for each.
Do 5 information-search readings against the clock, 4 minutes each. Scan for dates, prices and conditions.
Read 1 library story at a steady pace: The Person at the Station.
Do 10 minutes of listening a day, 70 minutes this week. Check the script after every clip.
Review 35 kanji from earlier weeks. Review only, no new kanji.

weeks.done: You redid your wrong grammar, timed 5 readings, and listened 70 minutes.

weeks.title: Second full mock

tasks.text: Take the full mock again at real exam time, 115 minutes. It is the same questions, so the score is not the point. The time practice is.
Write down 3 numbers from the results: LK plus Reading, Listening, Total.
Redo 10 questions you still miss. Say why each wrong choice is wrong.
Do 10 minutes of listening a day, 70 minutes this week. Check the script after every clip.

weeks.done: You finished the second mock and compared your 3 numbers with Checkpoint 1.

weeks.title: Light and steady

tasks.text: Read your mistake notebook for 20 minutes a day, 140 minutes this week. Add nothing new.
Go to bed at the same time on all 7 nights.
Do 10 minutes of easy listening a day, 70 minutes this week.
Start 0 new grammar, 0 new words, 0 new kanji. New material now only creates worry.

weeks.done: You read the notebook every day and slept on schedule.

weeks.title: Last 2 days and the test

tasks.text: Pack 5 things the night before: admission ticket, photo ID, HB pencils, eraser, a watch that makes no sound. The organizer's notice comes first.
Check the route to the test room once, and plan to arrive 30 minutes early.
Read the section flow below once. Know how many seconds you have per question in each of the 3 sections.
Skim the mistake notebook for 15 minutes, then stop for the day.

weeks.done: Your bag is packed and you know the 3 sections by heart.
